root_cause_label: Agent assumed python3 -m pip targets the system-wide interpreter without verifying; pip installed fasttext into /opt/miniswea virtual environment, leaving the actual system-wide Python at /usr/local/lib/python3.13 unchanged and the NumPy 2.x incompatibility unaddressed
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent installed fasttext into a non-system virtual environment (/opt/miniswea) after misreading the task requirement for the system-wide Python interpreter, then conducted all verification in that same wrong environment and declared success without ever touching the required system site-packages or addressing the NumPy 2.x incompatibility.
t_err_evidence: python3 -m pip install fasttext installed into /opt/miniswea with numpy 2.4.0, wrong environment and incompatible NumPy
t_commit_evidence: After step 3 installs fasttext into the wrong environment, all subsequent steps (4-8) verify against that environment and the agent never pivots; the outcome is locked from this point as no system-side changes were made.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed that 'python3 -m pip' targets the system-wide Python interpreter, acting on this unverified assumption. The pip output at step 3 clearly reveals the wrong path (/opt/miniswea), but the agent ignores this contradictory evidence and proceeds with the false belief that the installation succeeded in the correct environment.
